back_translation: Then a shoot will break out from the stump of Jesse, and a branch from his roots will bear fruit.
And the Spirit of the LORD will rest upon him — the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and mighty power, the Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD.
His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what his royal eyes see, nor decide by what his royal ears hear,

but he will judge the needy with righteousness and decide with equity for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.
Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the sash around his loins.
The wolf will dwell with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down beside the young goat; the calf and the young lion and the fattened ox will be together, and a little child will lead them.
The cow will graze with the bear; their young will lie down together; and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
The nursing infant will play over the cobra's hole, and the newly weaned child will reach his hand into the viper's nest.
They will neither harm nor destroy in all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
In that day the Root of Jesse will stand erect as a signal banner for the peoples; the nations will seek Him, and His tranquil resting place will be full of glory.

In that day the Sovereign Master will stretch out His hand a second time to redeem back the remnant of His people — from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
He will lift up a signal banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; He will assemble the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
Then the envy of Ephraim will depart, and the enemies of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will not envy Judah, and Judah will no longer be hostile toward Ephraim.

But they will swoop down on the hill-shoulder of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. They will stretch out their hand over Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will obey them.

And the LORD will utterly destroy the gulf of the Sea of Egypt; He will wave His hand over the Euphrates River with a scorching wind and strike it into seven streams, so that men can cross over in their sandals.
And there will be a highway for the remnant of His people who are left from Assyria, as there was for Israel in the day they came up from the land of Egypt.
